significance: Dated by its foundation plaque to 1758 and built by the Mallabhum king Chaitanya Singha, this eka-ratna temple carries a domed shikhara over a square curved roof. Terracotta plaques on the walls show Ramayana episodes, Anantasayin Vishnu and repeated Radha-Krishna figures; the ASI protects it and it sits on UNESCO's tentative list with the rest of Bishnupur.
